subject: Compliance platform sourcing: automated evidence bakeoff (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance platform sourcing: automated evidence bakeoff (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)

Team,

Quick background: our current coverage for automated SOC2/Security evidence is fragmented (mix of manual trackers + a legacy pilot with Vanta). The Vanta pilot contract ends Oct 31 and we need a decision on which compliance automation platform we will standardize on for the next 12–24 months.

I propose a 3–4 week bakeoff run starting Sep 7 that tests each vendor on:
- onboarding speed (Windows to production evidence in days)
- breadth of out-of-the-box control mapping and evidence collection
- integrations: Okta, GCP/KMS, SSO, logging/retention exports
- ability to export evidence for audits + retention policy enforcement
- pricing model alignment (monthly vs committed seats)
- enterprise requirements: SSO, KMS/HSM, subprocessor transparency, data residency

Please:
1) Confirm the evaluation criteria above or add any must-haves by EOD Aug 31.
2) Nominate the technical lead who will run infra onboarding for each vendor.
3) Confirm whether we should include a 3rd-party audit consultant for the bakeoff (I recommend Purple Assurance as a light engagement to validate evidence).

Attached: current_vendor_inventory.xlsx (current pilot notes + integrations)

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Procurement (Security tooling)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance platform sourcing: automated evidence bakeoff (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter)

Thanks Irene — good call. I’ve sketched a lightweight scoring matrix and suggested weights; attached as compliance_bakeoff_matrix.xlsx. High-level notes:
- Drata: fastest onboarding (they have a prebuilt GCP + Okta connector we used at prior company). Good evidence capture for infra controls, slightly higher seat-based pricing.
- Vanta: very configurable, slightly lower price at scale, onboarding requires more manual control mapping in our environment.
- TrustCenter: strong marketplace integrations and SOC2 workflow, better for vendor sharing but fewer low-level infra connectors out-of-the-box.

Proposed weights: Coverage 30%, Onboarding 20%, Integrations 20%, Pricing 20%, Enterprise features (KMS/SSO) 10%. We can adjust if Legal/Infra have different priorities.

I volunteer to run the vendor matrix and coordinate demos. Suggest Neha own procurement negotiation, Markus own infra validation, Laura own contract/SOW reviews. I’ll set up a shared calendar for vendor demos week of Sep 14.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Product Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Reynolds <emma@vanta.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam D. <sam.d@drata.com>, TrustCenter Sales <sales@trustcenter.io>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Vanta: tailored quote + quick onboarding notes for Redwood Inference

Irene / Marissa — thanks for the heads up and the proposed bakeoff. Attached is a tailored quote (Vanta-Quote-Redwood-2026-09.pdf) that includes a 15% pilot discount and an accelerated onboarding add-on if you want our professional services to map controls (2 week engagement).

Key clarifications from our side:
- Data residency: we can separate evidence exports regionally; we’ll need a brief security design call to confirm KMS flow for exported evidence.
- Pricing: quoted per seat + connector add-ons; the attached has both monthly and annual commitment numbers.
- Demos: I can run a 45-minute hands-on demo and do a short onboarding checklist with your infra lead (we’ll need Okta and GCP read-only creds).

Next steps:
1) Confirm if you want PS-led onboarding (suggested if you want results within 10 business days).
2) Provide preferred demo windows (week of Sep 14).

Best,
Emma Reynolds
Enterprise Lead — Vanta
emma@vanta.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance platform sourcing: automated evidence bakeoff (Vanta / Drata / TrustCenter) — next steps

Thanks all. Quick call decisions summarised:
- Bakeoff approved: Sep 7–Oct 2 (vendor demos week of Sep 14; 2-week onboarding windows thereafter).
- Owners: Neha (procurement lead & pricing negotiation), Markus (infra validation & test accounts), Laura (legal + SOW/contract redlines), Marissa (evaluation matrix & demo coordination).
- Budget: estimate $45k–$120k ARR range depending on PS + seat commitments; Neha to confirm target ceiling by Sep 8.
- Vendor asks: Emma (Vanta) — provide PS scope and SOC2 export sample (done). Sam (Drata) and TrustCenter — please provide equivalent quotes and export examples by Sep 10.
- Consultant: agreed to engage Purple Assurance for a 3-day evidence validation at ~ $6k; procurement to raise PO if needed.

Neha — please open a procurement ticket and attach the vendor quotes and matrix when available. Laura — can you schedule a 30-min legal intake to agree non-negotiables (data residency, subprocessor clause, SLA)? Markus — I'll ping infra with the GCP read-only checklist.

Irene

Head of Procurement (Security tooling)
